segments.ja44:1.1: Seyyo amitto matiyā upeto, na tveva mitto mativippahīno;
segments.ja44:1.3: Makasaṃ vadhissanti hi eḷamūgo, putto pitu abbhidā uttamaṅganti.

lines: Putto pitu abbhidā uttamaṅganti attano bālatāya puttopi hutvā pitu uttamaṅgaṃ matthakaṃ “makasaṃ paharissāmī”ti dvidhā bhindi.
Tasmā bālamittato paṇḍitaamittova seyyoti imaṃ gāthaṃ vatvā bodhisatto uṭṭhāya yathākammaṃ gato.
